svg.title: Ice skate under the wearer’s right boot - the NEAR side of the three-quarter pose. Two holder posts and one long runner, drawn deliberately oversized: a scale blade is 3 px at design resolution and 1 px on a phone, which is not a cue. The runner is 12 px deep so that six of them survive the 6 px silhouette stroke, and it overhangs the toe by 15 px and the heel by 13, because length under the boot is the part of a skate that is still there at 390 px.
